legal_registration.name: Register SARL
legal_registration.description: Official registration of a Société à Responsabilité Limitée at the commercial registry per Tunisian Commercial Code.

steps.name: Draft articles of association
steps.description: Prepare legal articles per Tunisian law

steps.name: Deposit capital at bank
steps.description: Deposit minimum capital (TND 1000 for SARL)

steps.name: Register with commercial court
steps.description: File registration documents with commercial registry

legal_registration.name: Register SA
legal_registration.description: Official registration of a Société Anonyme with shareholder requirements per Tunisian Commercial Code.
required_documents: Proof of address of registered office

steps.name: Prepare shareholder registry
steps.description: Create shareholder list with ownership percentages

steps.name: Appoint board of directors
steps.description: Select and document board members

steps.name: Register with commercial court
steps.description: File registration documents with commercial registry

tax_compliance.name: Tax Compliance
tax_compliance.description: Obtain tax identification and register for VAT with Tunisian tax authority.

steps.name: Apply for tax ID
steps.description: Register with tax authority to obtain NIF (Numéro d'Identification Fiscale)

steps.name: Register for VAT
steps.description: Enroll in VAT program if annual turnover exceeds TND 50,000

auditing_reporting.name: Large Company Reporting
auditing_reporting.description: Additional reporting obligations for companies with more than 50 employees per Tunisian Labor and Commercial Code.

steps.name: Submit workforce report
steps.description: File employment statistics with labor authority within 90 days of fiscal year end

steps.name: File annual audited accounts
steps.description: Submit audited financials to commercial registry within 90 days

licensing.name: Finance Sector Licensing
licensing.description: Obtain authorization from the Central Bank of Tunisia for financial activities.
licensing.authority: Central Bank of Tunisia (Banque Centrale de Tunisie)
required_documents: Business plan and financial projections (3-5 years)
Board member and senior management background checks

steps.name: Submit license application
steps.description: File with central bank with complete documentation

steps.name: Provide AML/KYC policy
steps.description: Submit comprehensive anti-money laundering and know-your-customer policies

licensing.name: Healthcare Licensing
licensing.description: Obtain approval from the Ministry of Health for medical services in Tunisia.
licensing.authority: Ministry of Health (Ministère de la Santé)
required_documents: Facility floor plan and equipment inventory
Infection control and waste management plan

steps.name: Submit medical facility application
steps.description: Register facility with ministry with complete documentation

steps.name: Provide staff certifications
steps.description: Submit credentials of medical professionals (doctors, nurses)

tech_ip_compliance.name: Tech/IP Compliance
tech_ip_compliance.description: Register intellectual property and ensure data protection compliance per Tunisian IP and Data Protection laws.
tech_ip_compliance.authority: National Institute for Intellectual Property (INPI) & National Data Protection Authority

steps.name: Register patents or trademarks
steps.description: File IP with INPI if applicable to your business

steps.name: Comply with data protection law
steps.description: Implement data protection compliance per Tunisian Personal Data Protection Law

special_zones.name: Free Zone Compliance
special_zones.description: Special customs and trade procedures for companies in Tunisian free zones (Enclaves Franches).
required_documents: Proof of business establishment in free zone

steps.name: Register with free zone authority
steps.description: Enroll in free zone program with required documents

steps.name: Obtain customs clearance
steps.description: Get trade authorization and customs procedures documentation

startup_incentives.name: Startup Label Application
startup_incentives.description: Apply for Tunisian Startup Label (Label Startup Tunisie) to benefit from tax and legal incentives.
startup_incentives.authority: Ministry of Economy and Digital Transformation (Direction of Innovation and Competitiveness)
required_documents: Confirmation of innovation and growth potential

steps.name: Prepare application dossier
steps.description: Compile all required documents demonstrating innovation criteria

steps.name: Submit to competent authority
steps.description: File application within 365 days of incorporation with Ministry

steps.name: Obtain label certification
steps.description: Receive Startup Label valid for 2920 days (8 years) with tax benefits
